code.execution.run-mode.label: New agent runs start in
code.execution.run-mode.help: Ask and Plan only look; Regular checks before big steps.

safety.rules.chat-mode.label: New chats start in
safety.rules.chat-mode.help: No pauses skips prompts; file and command guards still apply.

code.execution.execution-strategy.label: Who carries out actions
code.execution.execution-strategy.help: Puppet Master doing every action keeps all guards in charge.

options.Delegated Agent Execution: The agent's own app, in a sealed copy

code.execution.strategy-override.label: Let Regular runs use the agent's own app
code.execution.strategy-override.help: Only for app-based providers that allow it.

options.Force Delegated (DAE): Yes, when the provider allows it

safety.rules.permission-preset.label: Profile in use
safety.rules.permission-preset.help: Built-in profiles are presets; your own profiles count as Custom.
safety.rules.permission-preset.why: Pick a profile under Profiles; its safety level is set for you.

safety.rules.ui-mode.label: Permissions view
safety.rules.ui-mode.help: Expert adds ordered rules, scopes and outside folders.

safety.rules.scoped-overrides.label: Let parts of the project have their own rules
safety.rules.scoped-overrides.help: Narrower rules can only take freedom away, never add it.

safety.rules.scope-selector.label: Editing rules for
safety.rules.scope-selector.help: Narrower layers win over wider ones.

safety.rules.rule-editor.label: Ordered rules
safety.rules.rule-editor.help: Checked top to bottom; the last matching rule wins.

safety.rules.default-tool-permission.label: Anything without a rule
safety.rules.default-tool-permission.help: What happens when no rule matches a tool.

safety.rules.per-tool-permissions.label: Answer for each tool
safety.rules.per-tool-permissions.help: Reading and searching are safe to allow.
safety.rules.per-tool-permissions.why: Drawn as a table with one line per tool under Permissions › Rules.

safety.protection.web-tool-permissions.label: Answer for each web ability
safety.protection.web-tool-permissions.help: Search, read pages, extract, research, crawl and map.
safety.protection.web-tool-permissions.why: Drawn as a table with one line per tool under Permissions › Rules.

safety.rules.layer-origin-badge.label: Show where each rule comes from
safety.rules.layer-origin-badge.help: A small tag names the layer that set it.

safety.rules.capability-disclosure.label: Show what was held back
safety.rules.capability-disclosure.help: When the assistant gets less than it asked for, say why.

safety.rules.storage-format.label: Rules file
safety.rules.storage-format.help: Where your rules are saved; editing by hand is rarely needed.

safety.protection.filesafe-integration.label: Protect files and commands
safety.protection.filesafe-integration.help: If protection can't start, risky actions are blocked.

safety.protection.file-guard.label: Only change files the work said it would
safety.protection.file-guard.help: Stops surprise edits outside the current task.

safety.protection.strict-mode.label: Check writes strictly
safety.protection.strict-mode.help: Turn off only if normal edits keep getting blocked.

safety.protection.governance-unlock.label: Protected paths need extra sign-off
safety.protection.governance-unlock.help: Changing them needs more than a normal OK.

safety.protection.allow-destructive.label: Let dangerous commands through
safety.protection.allow-destructive.help: Overrides the block list; each use still asks.

safety.protection.approved-commands.label: Commands you trust
safety.protection.approved-commands.help: Exempt from the block list; added from chat approvals.

safety.protection.custom-patterns-path.label: Extra block list file
safety.protection.custom-patterns-path.help: More patterns to block; it can't unblock anything.

safety.protection.external-dir-action.label: Outside the project
safety.protection.external-dir-action.help: Folders on the list below skip this question.

safety.protection.external-dir-allowlist.label: Folders it may use without asking

safety.protection.qa-gate-override.label: Allow resets while tests check work
safety.protection.qa-gate-override.help: For example resetting a test database.

safety.protection.security-audit-overrid.label: Let the security check read secret files

safety.approvals.autonomy-mode.label: How runs pause
safety.approvals.autonomy-mode.help: Ask at checkpoints turns on the pauses below.

safety.approvals.gate-seam.label: Pause before each big stretch of work
safety.approvals.gate-seam.help: The run waits for your OK at each seam.

safety.approvals.gate-package.label: Pause before each package
safety.approvals.gate-package.help: The run waits for your OK before the next package.

safety.approvals.gate-lane.label: Pause before each lane
safety.approvals.gate-lane.help: The most frequent pause; expect many questions.

safety.approvals.auto-continue.label: After one OK, keep going
safety.approvals.auto-continue.help: Later pauses are skipped once you approve one.

safety.approvals.pre-run-display.label: Show commands before they run
safety.approvals.pre-run-display.help: See the command, folder and risk before you approve.

safety.approvals.wake-scheduler.label: Continue as soon as you answer
safety.approvals.wake-scheduler.help: Otherwise the run waits for its next check.

safety.protection.safe-point-restore.label: Undo the attempt when you reject it
safety.protection.safe-point-restore.help: Work restarts from the last good point.

safety.approvals.recovery-actions.label: Choices on a blocked action
safety.approvals.recovery-actions.help: The buttons you see when something is blocked.

safety.approvals.hitl-aware-defaults.label: Be stricter when you're away
safety.approvals.hitl-aware-defaults.help: Unattended runs use stricter answers automatically.

safety.approvals.lease-normalization.label: An OK covers only the exact command

safety.approvals.plan-mode-boundary.label: Plan only can never change files

safety.approvals.boundary-default-strict.label: How far one write approval reaches

ai.usage.run-spend-budget.label: Spending limit per run
ai.usage.run-spend-budget.help: 0 means no limit; set when the run starts.

ai.usage.max-tool-rounds.label: Steps per agent
ai.usage.max-tool-rounds.help: Stops endless back-and-forth before it costs you.

ai.usage.max-goal-turns.label: Rounds before a Goal checks in
ai.usage.max-goal-turns.help: Automatic uses the Goal's own limit.

ai.usage.subagent-wave-cost.label: Spending limit per helper wave
ai.usage.subagent-wave-cost.help: Stops a burst of parallel helpers overspending.

ai.usage.node-timeout.label: Time limit per step
ai.usage.node-timeout.help: Can tighten the run's limit, never exceed it.

options.long_wait: Mark it as waiting a long time

memory.limits.run-token-budget.label: Tokens one run may use
memory.limits.run-token-budget.help: The run stops and asks before going past this.

memory.limits.goal-token-budget.label: Tokens one Goal may use
memory.limits.goal-token-budget.help: Across every run of the Goal. Empty means no cap of its own.

code.execution.mode-overlay.label: Extra working style
code.execution.mode-overlay.help: Debug, interview or brainstorm on top of the mode above; it never allows more than that mode.
